subject: Revise outdated text index comments (#1231)
reason: The change only revises comments in rax_wrapper.h and text_index.h and deletes an unused private member (track_subtree_item_counts_) and its unused accessor (TrackSubtreeItemsCountEnabled) — a grep over the repository at the change shows no remaining references, so it was dead code. No runtime behaviour, replies, persistence or concurrency semantics change, so no scenario is needed.
